question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mischievious**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is '**Mischievous**'.
 
• **Mischievous **refers to causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful or harmless way. (शरारतपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example**: *The mischievous kitten batted at the ornaments on the Christmas tree, delighting in the chaos it caused but never intending any harm.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Acquiesce**: To accept something reluctantly but without protest. (संतुष्ट होना)
 
• **Artificial**: Something made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally. (कृत्रिम)
 
• **Conscientious**: A person who is diligent, careful, and thorough in their work or duties. (ईमानदार)
